A Johar Town venue for your big day

Al-Jannat Marriage Hall is a wedding and banquet hall at Civic Center, Block C Phase 1, Johar Town, Lahore. Families book it for barat, walima and mehndi functions, choosing between three halls — Pearl, Crystal and Haveli — on a single site.

Food is handled by the hall's in-house catering, with menus that can be customised for your function, and parking is available for guests. There are no prices listed publicly — every booking is quoted on call, based on your date, hall and menu.
